name: bluebox
description: Connect your coding agent to Bluebox, the observability agent for AI-native development. Check production before planning a change, pick up a Bluebox investigation's root cause, and add OpenTelemetry to your services. Requires a Bluebox account.

interface.longDescription: Bring Bluebox into Codex. Check how a service behaves in production before planning a change, pick up the root cause of a Bluebox investigation, and add OpenTelemetry to your services. Includes five Bluebox skills and the Bluebox MCP server, which you sign in to with OAuth on first use. Requires a Bluebox account; the bluebox CLI is optional.
defaultPrompt: Check production for this service before we change it
Load the root cause of my latest Bluebox investigation
Add OpenTelemetry to this service and send its telemetry to Bluebox
